Response: I’ll commit to 15 tons this month if all five explicitly agree, and I support taking 5 each if next month’s stock is 50.

There’s also a useful long-run comparison: if everyone follows that stock-dependent plan, we’d spend about three-quarters of our months at 100 tons earning $15,000 each and one-quarter at 50 earning $5,000 each. That averages $12,500 per person per month, versus $10,000 under the always-full-stock plan. It isn’t proof this is the best possible policy, and it depends on everyone cooperating, but it gives us a reason to try it beyond just earning more today.

John, are you willing to join on those terms? We still need your agreement and Kate’s before treating this as settled.
Conversation conclusion by me: no
Next speaker: John
